title: From English-Centric to Effective Bilingual: LLMs with Custom Tokenizers for Underrepresented Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance disparity and tokenization efficiency between English and underrepresented languages with non-Latin scripts (Ukrainian, Arabic, Georgian) using metrics such as Tokenizer Fertility, Non-Existing Words Ratio (NEWR), Code Switching Word Ratio (CSWR), and manual Grammar Correctness Scores (GCS).
